title: The Penny Is Ending, But The Nickel Loses Even More
hook: America is killing its oldest coin to stop losing money.
closing: The penny's long run ends because minting pocket change stopped making financial sense.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: Making pennies loses taxpayers 86 million dollars yearly, so ending production saves money.
That decision ends the penny's 232-year run, far longer than other discontinued coins.
Yet a nickel costs 13.78 cents to make, proving the penny was not the worst offender.
